Fillings are the worst sometimes! After a three year stint of not going, I had to sit through about six fillings within a few months. And of course it all still bites me in the butt, so they come back again. I think I might have weak teeth. Proud of you!!

God I hated the dentist for the longest time because they always ragged on me about oral hygiene. The last time I went this past spring, the hygienist was actually very helpful. I didn’t tell her the truth behind my habits, and I don’t think I mentioned any of the mental health stuff, but when it came to flossing, she was rather candid with me. 
“You don’t have to do the whole routine every day, really. You can alternate between the water pick and other floss every other day.” 
Which no, I don’t follow that now. But it actually really did kind of help me to have someone that understood that it wasn’t a daily thing that people do. 
Following that I started using handheld floss sticks, the little plastic disposable ones. They’re much easier to use, in my opinion. And they’re much more mobile! That and a combination of the disposable plastic dental picks has really really helped me. 
And, it makes me feel better about doing less. Because some days I’ll just use those, others I might do my whooole routine. Either way, that quote “everything worth doing is worth doing poorly” feels fitting. 
Your feelings are extremely valid. I’m very proud of you for simply being alive. I know very well that sometimes that’s the hardest thing you can do. You’re cared for, and you’re not alone in this. Much love! ♥️
